title: Smokebridge promote mesh with deferred telemetry guardrails and rollback rehearsal
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: we observed intermittent post-promote regressions caused by telemetry lag and late-arriving session affinity events during small-scale rollouts. This PR introduces a 'smokebridge' promote mesh: a thin deferred-forwarding layer that holds promotion traffic in a short-lived buffer until a lightweight telemetry gate confirms signal arrival consistency. The mesh is designed to be pluggable into existing rollout controllers and exercises the rollback rehearsal path automatically if telemetry does not reach quorum within a configured timeout. Approach: add smokebridge controller + CRD (config defaults to 30s hold, quorum=75%), integrate with promote mesh so that immediate promotes enter a transient held state; implement a rehearse mode that runs a no-op rollback against a shadow snapshot to validate rollback paths are healthy before committing final promote. Also: add metrics (bridge_hold_seconds, bridge_quorum_ok, rollback_rehearsal_success), tracing hooks to correlate held sessions to promote decisions, and e2e tests that simulate delayed telemetry and session churn. Testing: unit tests for controller state transitions, integration harness that replays delayed traces, and a canary job that exercised promote+rehearse on staging. Risk and mitigation: default behavior is OFF for existing rollouts; configuration gate and feature flag provided; mesh defaults to conservative parameters to avoid user impact. Rollback rehearsal is non-destructive by design and runs against the promote snapshot only when rehearse=true. Documentation: console docs page + API update for new CRD fields. See linked Linear tickets for rollout gating scopes.
commits: feat(smokebridge): add controller, CRD and reconciliation loop | feat(promote): wire promote flow to smokebridge hold state | test(integration): delayed-telemetry harness and staging canary | perf: optimize hold buffer memory path | docs: api and console docs for smokebridge

release_notes: Added 'Smokebridge' promote mesh to defer final promotes until telemetry quorum is observed; includes optional rollback rehearsal to validate rollback paths. Disabled by default; enable via feature flag or CRD. Improves safety for low-latency rollouts when telemetry arrivals are delayed.
notes_for_ops: Default install will not change runtime behavior. Operators enabling smokebridge should tune hold_timeout and quorum_pct based on median telemetry latency; recommended hold_timeout=30s, quorum_pct=75. Rehearse mode should be enabled in staging before production. Metrics: smokebridge_bridge_hold_seconds, smokebridge_quorum_ok (0/1), smokebridge_rehearsal_success (0/1).
testing_instructions: 1) Deploy to staging with feature flag smokebridge.enabled=true and rehearse=true; 2) Trigger a small promote and use the integration harness to delay telemetry by 40s to validate hold; 3) Observe metrics and confirm rehearse path runs and reports success; 4) Toggle rehearse=false and ensure promote proceeds after quorum; 5) Run rollback simulation: promote then trigger negative metric and confirm automated rollback works end-to-end.
related_work: Runs alongside existing rollout controllers and can be toggled per-promote. Complements ENG-8123 (promote telemetry improvements) and ENG-8291 (rollback hardening).
